content:
In addition to macOS 26.6, Apple has simultaneously released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, which include important bug fixes. Details are as follows.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 are finally officially released

After going through as many as seven Release Candidates, Apple has finally officially released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

The versions released this time are the same as last week's Release Candidates:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Apple's release notes only state that these two updates provide "important security fixes" and recommend that all users still using macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia install them as soon as possible.

Over the past few weeks, Apple has released multiple security fixes for older system versions, many of which patched WebKit vulnerabilities that could put user data at risk. Therefore, if you are still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia, it is recommended that you install these updates as soon as possible.

Update: Apple has now published the full security content for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, detailing a total of more than 138 different vulnerabilities across the two systems.

Are you still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
